push.title: D 1-1 vs Wetter FC | You: 7.7
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.7. I've seen you do better, which is exactly why I'm not worried.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Wetter FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's the sound of the scoreboard saying thank you.
+ Man of the Match, your 20th for us. The game noticed, and so did I.
+ Giveaways 4, down from your usual 8. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 8th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Drew 1-1 with Wetter FC. A point earned is a point we didn't have.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Back to basics: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. Next match, nail it.
- shot selection needs work from you and BellyTb1. Easy plan: cut it back to each other.
- On-ball actions 22, down from your usual 32. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 4. That needs to look different next time out.
- 0.3 below your usual. Shake it off like a wet dog.

Daily reps: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Remember, buddskees: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

You're closer than you think. Trust the process, and trust your teammates. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 1-1 vs Wetter FC | You: 6.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 6.9. I believe in you just as much as I did this morning. Maybe more.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership.
+ Your passes to buddskees had perfect weight and perfect timing.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (20 vs their best 16). That's growth you can count.
+ Team-high 4 tackles attempted. More of that, please and thank you.
+ 1-1 with Wetter FC. A draw is a win that hasn't figured itself out yet.

THE BAD
- No shots. Here's the trick: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on. It's coming.
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Keep this in your pocket: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Brick by brick.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 29%. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.9, down from your usual 8.5. Not good enough. Not close.

Coach's drill: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

Hey, PhogsToffees. Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

I'm in your corner, always. - Coach Lasso
